title: Methods for Studying Circular RNAs in Viral Oncogenesis.
snippet: Circular RNAs (circRNAs) are single-stranded, covalently closed RNA molecules expressed across diverse organisms, including humans and viruses. Emerging evidence indicates that circRNAs are critical modulators of the interplay between viral persistence, immune evasion, and oncogenesis. Viral- and host-derived circRNAs can rewire cellular signaling pathways....
